name: Dependency Timeout & Hang
description: Downstream service hangs or stalls rather than failing fast.
key_questions: What timeout bounds every outbound network or DB call?|Does a downstream hang exhaust connection pools or worker threads?|Are circuit breakers or bulkheads isolating slow dependencies?

name: Retry Storm & Amplification
description: Blind retries multiply load on an already-degraded dependency.
key_questions: Which operations are retried, with what jittered backoff and max attempt cap?|Are retried writes idempotent?|What stops cascading retries across multiple service hops?

name: Third-Party Quota & Rate Limit
description: External API or vendor throttles requests under spike or batch load.
key_questions: What happens when a vendor returns 429 or hits a daily quota?|Are requests queued, shed, or degraded gracefully?|Who alerts before quota exhaustion hits production?

name: Thundering Herd & Cache Stampede
description: Cold cache or synchronized reconnects overwhelm origin stores.
key_questions: What happens if Redis/cache flushes or expires on a hot key simultaneously?|Are reconnects and scheduled jobs jittered?|Is request coalescing or stale-while-revalidate in place?

name: Poison-Pill Message or Job
description: A malformed event blocks a queue partition or crashes consumers in a loop.
key_questions: How many retries run before a message moves to a dead-letter queue?|Can one bad payload stall an entire consumer group?|How are dead-letter items inspected and replayed?

name: Partial Write & Dual-Store Drift
description: Work succeeds in one store or side effect and fails in another.
key_questions: Which state transitions span two stores without a transaction?|Are outbox patterns or compensating actions in place?|How is drift detected and reconciled?

name: Migration Lock & Skewed Deploy
description: Schema migration locks hot tables or breaks mixed old/new code during rollout.
key_questions: Are migrations backward-compatible with the previous running version?|Could an ALTER TABLE lock production traffic?|Can a deploy roll back safely after the migration runs?

name: Silent Data Loss or Corruption
description: Bad writes or truncated jobs succeed without tripping error alerts.
key_questions: What invariants or checksums verify critical writes?|Are destructive deletes soft, backed up, and tested for restore?|How quickly would silent corruption be noticed?

name: Secret, Key & Certificate Expiry
description: Expired TLS cert, API token, or signing key causes an outage.
key_questions: Which secrets, certs, and webhook keys expire, and how are they rotated without downtime?|Does rotation require a deploy or restart?|What monitors upcoming expiration?

name: Zone or Node Failure
description: A single host, container, or availability zone drops out.
key_questions: Can traffic drain cleanly on SIGTERM without dropping in-flight requests?|Are stateless nodes spread across failure domains?|What is the tested failover path for stateful stores?

name: Resource & Disk Exhaustion
description: Unbounded queues, logs, uploads, or payloads fill RAM or disk.
key_questions: What bounds upload sizes, batch sizes, and in-memory buffers?|Can log volume or temp files fill the host disk?|Are resource limits and autoscaling ceilings tested?

name: Clock Skew & Out-of-Order Events
description: Distributed timestamps or out-of-order webhooks corrupt state.
key_questions: Does business logic trust client clocks or unsorted event arrival?|Are webhook deliveries deduplicated and state-guarded against stale events?|Do distributed records use monotonic or server-assigned ordering?
